// A configured map projection. The false easting and northing offset all
// projected coordinates so they stay positive across the region of use.
type MapProjection
{
    Family: MapProjectionFamily;
    CentralMeridian: Angle;
    FalseEasting: Length;
    FalseNorthing: Length;
}
